title: Damages.
bodyHtml:
§663J-5  Damages.  An individual entitled to bring an action under section 663J-3 may recover all of the following damages:

     (1)  Economic damages proximately caused by coercion into sexual exploitation or being the subject of sex trafficking;

     (2)  Noneconomic damages proximately caused by coercion into sexual exploitation or being the subject of sex trafficking;

     (3)  Exemplary damages;

     (4)  Reasonable attorney's fees; and

     (5)  Costs of suit, including reasonable expenses for expert testimony. [L 1999, c 203, pt of §2; am L 2016, c 206, §6; am L 2025, c 20, §7]
